4 friends — Aria, Ben, Cora, and Dev — each have a different pet (Cat, Dog, Fish, Bird) and a different job (Doctor, Teacher, Engineer, Artist). Study the clues below and answer the questions that follow.

- Ben has the Cat.
- Dev is not the Artist.
- Aria has the Dog.
- Ben does not have the Bird.
- Aria does not have the Fish.
- Aria is not the Engineer.
- Cora is not the Artist.
- Aria is not the Doctor.
- Cora does not have the Dog.
- Dev does not have the Dog.
- Dev is not the Doctor.
- Cora is not the Engineer.
- Aria is not the Teacher.
- Dev is the Engineer.
- Ben is not the Teacher.
- Cora is not the Doctor.
- The Teacher has the Bird.
